'''Jemala Ha'rangir''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of [[Clan Ha'rangir]], however she defected from the [[Hidden Chain]] due to her love for [[Ora Nem]], causing [[Heta Kol]] to put a bounty on her head.<ref name="TOR:OK" />

==Biography==
A member of [[Clan Ha'rangir]], she was one of [[Heta Kol]] and the Hidden Chain's most loyal supporters, holding a position within the Hidden Chain that [[Jekiah Ordo]] described as 'very comfortable'; She was part of an elite team that captured [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals so that Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain might benefit from them. It was during her activities in this team that she met [[Ora Nem]], as she had been assigned to capture her. Jemala took Ora, along with other prisoners, to a prison ship, however as they were en route to the ship it got attacked and the Hidden Chain was plunged into chaos. Jemala took this opportunity to free Ora and the others, then helped them escape. This angered Heta Kol, and she put an bounty on the two, specifically for [[Sanlo Raal]] and her [[Raal's Regulators|crew]]. Jemala and Ora ended up hiding in a small safehouse, north of [[Camp Karnori]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:OK"/>

Jekiah received a distress signal that he believed was sent by Jemala, and sent the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Akaavi Spar]] to try and broker a deal with Jemala, however when the two first arrived in the [[Jundland Safehouse|safehouse]], Jemala attacked them, believing them to be working for Raal, but they were prevented from fighting further when Ora appeared. Recognizing that there was some miscommunication happening, Jemala and the Alliance Commander started to talk about what was happening. Jemala agreed that, if the Alliance Commander dealt with Raal and Raal's thugs, then she would provide information on the Hidden Chain, provided that she and Ora were allowed to go free. The Commander agreed, and killed Raal and her crew. Returning to Jemala, Jemala then handed over the information about Heta Kol that she knew, namely that she was traveling through [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] space unopposed and uncloaked, which suggested that she had help from someone amongst the Sith. The Commander then suggested that they escort Jemala and Ora to [[Odessen]], where they could start their life anew, which the pair agreed to.<ref name="TOR:OK"/>

Jemala would later provide Jekiah with intel on Hidden Chain supply convoys moving supplies and equipment through [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]], which he suspected was to build [[Darth Nul]]'s machine.<ref name="Into the Shadows">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Into the Shadows|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The choice to escort the couple to Odessen is the light-side choice. There are no dark-side choices, however the alternative is to leave them to fend for themselves, wherever that may be.

If the player chooses to escort them to Odessen, Jemala and Ora will make a brief background cameo in the final cutscene of ''Legacy Reborn'' alongside [[Sana-Rae]] and [[Kira Carsen]], as well as [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Arcann]] depending on the player's choices during one of the previous expansions, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''. If the player did not choose to escort Jemala and Ora to Odessen, they will be absent from the cutscene.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
